# Nishit Rana — Portfolio

## About
Nishit Rana is a backend software engineer specialising in edge platforms, distributed systems, and AI-driven workflows. Currently building with Go, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, and LLM tooling.

## Work
- **AGXP** — Edge request pipeline built on Cloudflare Workers. Handles auth, rate limiting, routing, and KV caching at the CDN edge. Case study available at /agxp.
- Open source contributions and side projects visible on GitHub: https://github.com/nrana-pixel

## Skills
Go, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, KV, R2, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
